violated_contract: A Firestore write whose transaction id was retired mid-flight must be retried on a fresh transaction, not surfaced as an unhandled error that loses the write.
canonical_prevention: Route every @firestore.transactional invocation in database/conversations.py through database._client.run_transactional so expired-transaction commits restart with a fresh transaction up to three attempts; under a contention retry budget, database/firestore_transaction_retry.py owns every attempt (inner attempts=1) and classifies expiry as contention inside its bounded, deadline-aware budget.
